about: Rankings: HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year (2011, 2013-2015) and Esports Earnings' 2012 CS:GO prize money. Configs come from public archives of pro CS:GO configs (mostly game-written config.cfg files in setup.gg's GitHub archive) and Liquipedia's settings tables. A date comes from the settings a file contains (checked against Valve's release notes), from a date written in the file or on its source (a header comment, Liquipedia's "Updated as of"), or else from the archive's commit date as an upper bound; each page lists its sources and how each date is known.

years.note: A CS 1.6 ranking (CS:GO came out in August 2012), so these are the players' CS:GO configs from later, each labelled with its date.

config.date_basis: A full config.cfg in the game's own format, from setup.gg's archive (uploaded 29 Apr 2016); the identical file, crosshair included, was already in the CSGO-Optimiser repository on 12 Jun 2014. It has the scoreboard-mouse setting added 23 Apr 2014 but none of the cl_hud_* settings added 1 May 2014, so it was saved in late April 2014. It lacks cl_inventory_saved_filter and cl_inventory_saved_sort, although the same 23 Apr 2014 update began saving the inventory sort and filter, and every other config in setup.gg's archive saved after that update has them, so the file may have been edited by hand before June 2014. cl_crosshairstyle 5 is in this file although Valve added style 5 only on 16 Jul 2014. Six configs in setup.gg's archive dated before July 2014 have it (GMX, NEO, TaZ, moE, pasha and schneider), as does a pasha config in CSGO-Optimiser saved between May 2013 and January 2014, so players set it before Valve added it. What the game drew for it then is unknown.
